title: ECL vivi-repair-failed-report profile v1
description: Vivi emits on the 3-failure threshold (I-5: Bounded recovery); consumed by VIGIL. Same structure as repair-failed-report.v1.json but pins eidolon: vivi. The kind stays 'repair-failed-report' — the shared kind is intentional; the emitter is distinguished by the envelope from.eidolon field.

attempts.description: MUST be >= 3 to trigger escalation per Vivi I-5 (Bounded recovery).

loop_iterations_used.description: Total closed-loop iterations consumed across all attempts for this failure category.
